svg.text: Depth, not width — a 1-DIN slot is 182 × 53 mm at the face and can be as little as 120 mm deep behind it. Measure the car, not the cage.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 8.8" bar LCD does not fit a 1-DIN fascia: ~217 mm against 180 mm. Desk use or a custom face only.
